text: Should the launch character stats use the original body ratios and should the frame passives scale them?
context:
The spec seeds per-character stats from today's `default`, `lightweight` and `reinforced` profiles (`content/catalogs/builds.ron`). Those are inconsistent: `default` was rescaled to 1000 health / 70 speed in the V12 closeout (commit 3eadd61b), but `lightweight` (85 health, 110 speed) and `reinforced` (120 health, 90 speed) were not. Copying them literally would give Light characters 85 health against 1000 and 57% more speed.

Separately, four characters offer Lightweight Frame or Reinforced Frame as a passive. Today those passives do nothing at runtime: they only chose the stat profile in the retired budget resolver, and saved brawlers could not pick them.

suggestions.text: Original ratios, frames scale the character
suggestions.detail:
- Base stats per body, using the original 85/100/120 health and 110/100/90 speed ratios: Light 850 health / 77 speed / reveal 192; Normal 1000 / 70 / 160; Heavy 1200 / 63 / 128. All recover 100/s.
- Lightweight Frame: ×0.85 health, ×1.10 speed. Reinforced Frame: ×1.20 health, ×0.90 speed, applied to the character's own stats. Both are tunable passive parameters.
- Every number stays tunable in Balance Lab (BRL-5v3c).

suggestions.text: All characters start at the default profile
suggestions.detail: - Every character starts at 1000 / 70 / 160; frames scale as above. Bodies differ only by their frame passive option until BRL-5v3c tunes them.

text: May Balance Lab lose its Fighters section until per-character tuning lands in BRL-5v3c?
context: Balance Lab's Fighters section edits the three shared stat profiles (`src/server/balance_lab/editor.rs` `add_fighter_fields`). With stats owned per character, those profiles no longer exist, so nothing would read the edited values.

suggestions.detail: The section and its persisted fields go away (snapshot schema bump; old lab snapshots fail closed as today). Weapons, ultimates, passives, map objects and effect tiles stay editable. BRL-5v3c adds a Characters section that edits each character's stats, weapon and options.

suggestions.text: Add a minimal per-character stats section in this ticket
suggestions.detail: Edit each character's health, speed and resistances now. This pulls part of BRL-5v3c forward and grows this already large change.
